prs.short_reason: [llm] cluster primary: Plain JSON Schema objects passed as inputSchema in the deprecated server.tool() overload are not handled correctly — both PRs patch the same code path in src/server/mcp.ts for this identical trigger condition, but with conflicting strategies: PR #1596 rejects them at runtime with a thrown error, while PR #1617 detects and preserves them. prs.cluster_pick_reason: PR #1617 preserves backward compatibility for callers using the deprecated server.tool() overload with raw JSON Schema, a legitimate pattern predating Zod schema requirements. PR #1596's heuristic (reject any object whose values include a nested object) would incorrectly reject valid ToolAnnotations containing nested values, making it brittle. PR #1617 also includes a type-level fix (widening inputSchema to ZodRawShapeCompat | AnySchema) that makes the intent explicit and compile-time safe, whereas #1596 is runtime-only with no type changes.

clusters.pick_reason: PR #1617 preserves backward compatibility for callers using the deprecated server.tool() overload with raw JSON Schema, a legitimate pattern predating Zod schema requirements. PR #1596's heuristic (reject any object whose values include a nested object) would incorrectly reject valid ToolAnnotations containing nested values, making it brittle. PR #1617 also includes a type-level fix (widening inputSchema to ZodRawShapeCompat | AnySchema) that makes the intent explicit and compile-time safe, whereas #1596 is runtime-only with no type changes.
